review_scope: Hosted source/report relationship verification; supplementary to active-machine T19 and M4 evidence.

raw_artifact_provenance.retained_scope: Known owned process-TEMP JSON reports, ownership marker and temporary verifier; retained without another cleanup request or retry.
raw_artifact_provenance.artifact_archive_digests: GitHub API metadata recorded in T19-ci-runs-final3.json; this review downloaded extracted JSON reports through gh and did not independently hash archive ZIP bytes.

scope.counting: Six child families counted once per shell:31 unit+22 dependency guards+51 package+7 required baseline+7 help+35 native=153; baseline three observed_behavior entries remain separate. Parent CI/dependency records are not extra groups.
scope.source_arrays: Every present source_before/source_after entry plus dependency lock/setup digests matched committed source variants, preserving UTF-8 BOM and allowing only LF/CRLF conversion.
scope.actual_context: Literal parent CI GitHub/runner fields retained; absent child GitHub fields remain null. No child fields synthesized from parent context.
scope.lineage: Complete Git tree identity and exact original source hashes bind integration checkout to C2 source despite different merge commit SHA.
scope.acceptance_limit: Does not prove Windows11 local milestone completion, exact release ZIP runtime smoke, physical phone evidence, authorized tag/release, main merge, or task acceptance.

equivalence_policy: Literal blob digest first; otherwise strict UTF-8 decoding preserves BOM and only CRLF/LF conversion. No trimming, content edits, BOM removal or byte substitution.

readme_normalization.policy: Owned README fixture only: remove CR byte only immediately before LF; preserve all other bytes, including UTF-8 BOM, existing LF and lone CR.

package_readme_lf_proof.verification_limit: Independently recomputed source variants/byte policy and checked original report hashes, counts, and config fields. Synthetic fixture Git objects/ZIP bytes lived on the hosted runner and are reported child evidence; they were not downloaded and re-opened here.

verified_gates.package_scope: Synthetic repository copy/build policy only; its synthetic source commit is not the checkout integration commit and it is not release candidate or device acceptance.
